
```{r import data set, results='hide', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Import the data set
Electricity <- read_excel(
  path = "./Data/Raw/load.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1", col_names = TRUE
)

# Check the N/A 
sum(is.na(Electricity))

# Format the data set 
Electricity_Processed  <- Electricity %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date)) %>%
  mutate(demand = rowMeans(select(., h1:h24), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  select(date, demand)

# Save in the processed folder 
write.xlsx(Electricity_Processed, "Data/Processed/Electricity_Processed.xlsx")


```
